# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 passed simulation, timing, and evidence gates, but kept LUT usage at 25, so it was rejected against the strict LUT-reduction objective. The editable top is a transparent wrapper around a frozen core that must remain live; the core contains the measured logic, leaving little source-level opportunity to reduce its resources. The top must retain `// @latency 33` and the specified cycle behavior.

## Hypothesis
Preserving the core hierarchy may change Vivado’s mapping enough to reduce routed LUT use below 25, though the result is uncertain and must pass every existing gate.

## Instruction for generator
Add the Vivado `keep_hierarchy = "yes"` attribute to the existing unconditional `spi_master_core #( .HALF_PERIOD(2) ) u_spi_master_core` instance. Keep every port connection direct and unchanged, and retain the matching latency annotation. This tests a hierarchy-mapping change after iteration 1’s unchanged direct wrapper; promote it only if routed LUTs are strictly lower than 25 and all verification, timing, and metric gates pass.
